1	-- =============================================================================
2	-- dobeu.net v3 — initial schema (2026-05-21)
3	-- Tables: profiles, projects, project_files, invoices, messages, leads,
4	--         bookings, page_events
5	-- RLS: enabled on every table. Users see own data; admins see all.
6	-- =============================================================================
7	
8	-- Extensions
9	create extension if not exists "uuid-ossp";
10	
11	-- =============================================================================
12	-- profiles — extends auth.users with app-specific fields
13	-- =============================================================================
14	create table public.profiles (
15	  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
16	  full_name text,
17	  company text,
18	  avatar_url text,
19	  apollo_contact_id text,
20	  is_admin boolean not null default false,
21	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
22	  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
23	);
24	
25	alter table public.profiles enable row level security;
26	
27	create policy "profiles_select_own" on public.profiles
28	  for select using (auth.uid() = id);
29	
30	create policy "profiles_update_own" on public.profiles
31	  for update using (auth.uid() = id);
32	
33	create policy "profiles_admin_all" on public.profiles
34	  for all using (
35	    exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
36	  );
37	
38	-- Auto-create profile on user signup
39	create or replace function public.handle_new_user()
40	returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public
41	as $$
42	begin
43	  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name, is_admin)
44	  values (
45	    new.id,
46	    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name',
47	    new.email = any(string_to_array(current_setting('app.admin_emails', true), ','))
48	  );
49	  return new;
50	end;
51	$$;
52	
53	create trigger on_auth_user_created
54	  after insert on auth.users
55	  for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();
56	
57	-- =============================================================================
58	-- projects
59	-- =============================================================================
60	create type project_status as enum ('proposed', 'active', 'delivered', 'closed');
61	
62	create table public.projects (
63	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
64	  owner_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
65	  title text not null,
66	  description text,
67	  status project_status not null default 'proposed',
68	  started_at timestamptz,
69	  delivered_at timestamptz,
70	  total_cents integer not null default 0,
71	  stripe_link text,
72	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
73	  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
74	);
75	
76	create index projects_owner_idx on public.projects(owner_user_id);
77	create index projects_status_idx on public.projects(status);
78	
79	alter table public.projects enable row level security;
80	
81	create policy "projects_select_own" on public.projects
82	  for select using (owner_user_id = auth.uid());
83	
84	create policy "projects_admin_all" on public.projects
85	  for all using (
86	    exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
87	  );
88	
89	-- =============================================================================
90	-- project_files
91	-- =============================================================================
92	create table public.project_files (
93	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
94	  project_id uuid not null references public.projects(id) on delete cascade,
95	  storage_path text not null,
96	  filename text not null,
97	  mime text,
98	  size_bytes bigint,
99	  uploaded_by uuid not null references auth.users(id),
100	  uploaded_at timestamptz not null default now(),
101	  retention_until timestamptz not null default (now() + interval '3 years')
102	);
103	
104	create index project_files_project_idx on public.project_files(project_id);
105	
106	alter table public.project_files enable row level security;
107	
108	create policy "project_files_select_own" on public.project_files
109	  for select using (
110	    exists (
111	      select 1 from public.projects p
112	      where p.id = project_files.project_id and p.owner_user_id = auth.uid()
113	    )
114	  );
115	
116	create policy "project_files_admin_all" on public.project_files
117	  for all using (
118	    exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
119	  );
120	
121	-- =============================================================================
122	-- invoices
123	-- =============================================================================
124	create type invoice_status as enum ('open', 'paid', 'void', 'overdue');
125	
126	create table public.invoices (
127	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
128	  project_id uuid not null references public.projects(id) on delete cascade,
129	  amount_cents integer not null,
130	  currency text not null default 'USD',
131	  status invoice_status not null default 'open',
132	  stripe_invoice_id text,
133	  stripe_payment_intent text,
134	  hosted_invoice_url text,
135	  due_date date,
136	  paid_at timestamptz,
137	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
138	);
139	
140	create index invoices_project_idx on public.invoices(project_id);
141	create index invoices_status_idx on public.invoices(status);
142	
143	alter table public.invoices enable row level security;
144	
145	create policy "invoices_select_own" on public.invoices
146	  for select using (
147	    exists (
148	      select 1 from public.projects p
149	      where p.id = invoices.project_id and p.owner_user_id = auth.uid()
150	    )
151	  );
152	
153	create policy "invoices_admin_all" on public.invoices
154	  for all using (
155	    exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
156	  );
157	
158	-- =============================================================================
159	-- messages
160	-- =============================================================================
161	create table public.messages (
162	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
163	  thread_id uuid not null,            -- equals project_id for project threads
164	  from_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id),
165	  to_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id),
166	  body text not null,
167	  read_at timestamptz,
168	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
169	);
170	
171	create index messages_thread_idx on public.messages(thread_id);
172	create index messages_recipient_idx on public.messages(to_user_id, read_at);
173	
174	alter table public.messages enable row level security;
175	
176	create policy "messages_select_participant" on public.messages
177	  for select using (from_user_id = auth.uid() or to_user_id = auth.uid());
178	
179	create policy "messages_insert_sender" on public.messages
180	  for insert with check (from_user_id = auth.uid());
181	
182	create policy "messages_update_recipient" on public.messages
183	  for update using (to_user_id = auth.uid());
184	
185	create policy "messages_admin_all" on public.messages
186	  for all using (
187	    exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
188	  );
189	
190	-- =============================================================================
191	-- leads — anonymous form submissions before signup
192	-- =============================================================================
193	create type lead_source as enum ('book', 'form', 'email', 'typeform', 'other');
194	
195	create table public.leads (
196	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
197	  email text not null,
198	  name text,
199	  company text,
200	  apollo_contact_id text,
201	  source lead_source not null default 'other',
202	  utm_source text,
203	  utm_medium text,
204	  utm_campaign text,
205	  utm_term text,
206	  utm_content text,
207	  referrer text,
208	  first_seen timestamptz not null default now(),
209	  last_seen timestamptz not null default now(),
210	  raw_payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb
211	);
212	
213	create index leads_email_idx on public.leads(email);
214	create index leads_source_idx on public.leads(source);
215	create index leads_last_seen_idx on public.leads(last_seen desc);
216	
217	alter table public.leads enable row level security;
218	
219	-- Anonymous users can insert (rate-limited at API layer)
220	create policy "leads_insert_anon" on public.leads
221	  for insert with check (true);
222	
223	create policy "leads_admin_select" on public.leads
224	  for select using (
225	    exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
226	  );
227	
228	create policy "leads_admin_update" on public.leads
229	  for update using (
230	    exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
231	  );
232	
233	-- =============================================================================
234	-- bookings
235	-- =============================================================================
236	create type booking_status as enum ('scheduled', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'noshow');
237	
238	create table public.bookings (
239	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
240	  lead_id uuid references public.leads(id) on delete set null,
241	  email text not null,
242	  name text,
243	  scheduled_at timestamptz not null,
244	  duration_minutes integer not null default 30,
245	  meeting_url text,
246	  apollo_meeting_id text,
247	  google_event_id text,
248	  status booking_status not null default 'scheduled',
249	  notes text,
250	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
251	);
252	
253	create index bookings_scheduled_idx on public.bookings(scheduled_at);
254	create index bookings_email_idx on public.bookings(email);
255	
256	alter table public.bookings enable row level security;
257	
258	create policy "bookings_insert_anon" on public.bookings
259	  for insert with check (true);
260	
261	create policy "bookings_admin_all" on public.bookings
262	  for all using (
263	    exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
264	  );
265	
266	-- =============================================================================
267	-- page_events — lightweight in-DB analytics mirror
268	-- =============================================================================
269	create table public.page_events (
270	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
271	  session_id text not null,
272	  user_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
273	  event_name text not null,
274	  properties jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
275	  page_path text,
276	  occurred_at timestamptz not null default now()
277	);
278	
279	create index page_events_session_idx on public.page_events(session_id);
280	create index page_events_event_idx on public.page_events(event_name, occurred_at desc);
281	
282	alter table public.page_events enable row level security;
283	
284	create policy "page_events_insert_anon" on public.page_events
285	  for insert with check (true);
286	
287	create policy "page_events_admin_select" on public.page_events
288	  for select using (
289	    exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
290	  );
291	
292	-- =============================================================================
293	-- updated_at trigger helper
294	-- =============================================================================
295	create or replace function public.set_updated_at()
296	returns trigger language plpgsql as $$
297	begin
298	  new.updated_at = now();
299	  return new;
300	end;
301	$$;
302	
303	create trigger profiles_updated_at before update on public.profiles
304	  for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();
305	
306	create trigger projects_updated_at before update on public.projects
307	  for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();
308	
309	-- =============================================================================
310	-- Storage bucket for project files
311	-- =============================================================================
312	insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public)
313	  values ('project-files', 'project-files', false)
314	  on conflict (id) do nothing;
315	
316	create policy "project_files_storage_select_own" on storage.objects
317	  for select using (
318	    bucket_id = 'project-files' and (
319	      -- Owner can read their own project files
320	      exists (
321	        select 1 from public.project_files pf
322	        join public.projects p on p.id = pf.project_id
323	        where pf.storage_path = name and p.owner_user_id = auth.uid()
324	      )
325	      or
326	      -- Admin can read all
327	      exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
328	    )
329	  );
330	
331	create policy "project_files_storage_admin_insert" on storage.objects
332	  for insert with check (
333	    bucket_id = 'project-files'
334	    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
335	  );
336	
337	create policy "project_files_storage_admin_delete" on storage.objects
338	  for delete using (
339	    bucket_id = 'project-files'
340	    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.is_admin = true)
341	  );

1	-- =============================================================================
2	-- dobeu.net v3 — Phase 1 reconciliation migration (2026-06-05) -- DRAFT
3	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
4	-- Per .agent/PRODUCTION-PLAN.md §6 (DB migration) + §7 (work-order ticketing).
5	--
6	-- DRAFT STATUS: do NOT apply against the legacy `db-dobeutech-unified` database
7	-- yet. This migration is staged so the target (Vercel-managed) Supabase can
8	-- accept the legacy dump after the inventory at `.agent/migration/inventory.md`
9	-- is filled in and the mapping SQL is authored.
10	--
11	-- What this migration does (and why):
12	--   1. Drop `messages` + its RLS policies (gate-4 decision: Intercom owns chat).
13	--   2. Neutralize RLS policies that key off `profiles.is_admin`
14	--      (gate-6 decision: ADMIN_EMAILS env is the single admin source of truth;
15	--      admin reads already flow through `createAdminClient()` -- service role,
16	--      bypasses RLS). The `profiles.is_admin` *column* is kept for now -- see
17	--      the TODO marker below -- only the dependent policies + trigger logic
18	--      are removed.
19	--   3. Add `invoices.hosted_invoice_url` (Stripe-hosted invoicing, gate-3).
20	--   4. Create `work_orders` + `work_order_attachments` + their enums + RLS
21	--      so Phase 2/3 UI has a target. RLS gates ownership; column-level
22	--      "client can only accept-quote" is enforced in the server action.
23	--   5. Provision the private `work-order-attachments` storage bucket + RLS
24	--      policies. Admin path bypasses via service role.
25	--
26	-- Style: mirrors `20260521000000_initial_schema.sql`. Idempotent where cheap
27	-- (`if exists` / `if not exists`) so reruns during cutover prep don't fail.
28	-- =============================================================================
29	
30	
31	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
32	-- 1. Drop `messages` (Intercom replaces it). Policies fall away with the table.
33	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
34	drop table if exists public.messages cascade;
35	
36	
37	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
38	-- 2. Neutralize `profiles.is_admin`-dependent RLS.
39	--    Admin reads route through `createAdminClient()` (service role bypasses RLS)
40	--    so the column-driven policies are dead weight and risk drift against the
41	--    real env-driven gate (`ADMIN_EMAILS`).
42	--
43	--    Keep the user-scoped own-row policies. Drop the admin_* policies. Replace
44	--    the previously broad `profiles_admin_all` policy with nothing -- nobody
45	--    queries `profiles` from the RLS path as an admin (it would go via service
46	--    role).
47	--
48	--    TODO Phase 5: physically drop profiles.is_admin once nothing references it
49	--    in app code or tooling (and remove the column from generated types).
50	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
51	drop policy if exists "profiles_admin_all"       on public.profiles;
52	drop policy if exists "projects_admin_all"       on public.projects;
53	drop policy if exists "project_files_admin_all"  on public.project_files;
54	drop policy if exists "invoices_admin_all"       on public.invoices;
55	drop policy if exists "leads_admin_select"       on public.leads;
56	drop policy if exists "leads_admin_update"       on public.leads;
57	drop policy if exists "bookings_admin_all"       on public.bookings;
58	drop policy if exists "page_events_admin_select" on public.page_events;
59	
60	-- Also drop the storage policies that gated on `profiles.is_admin`. Storage
61	-- access for admins flows through the service-role path going forward.
62	drop policy if exists "project_files_storage_select_own"   on storage.objects;
63	drop policy if exists "project_files_storage_admin_insert" on storage.objects;
64	drop policy if exists "project_files_storage_admin_delete" on storage.objects;
65	
66	-- Re-add the user-scoped read policy for `project-files` storage without the
67	-- is_admin branch. Admin access is now exclusively service-role.
68	create policy "project_files_storage_select_own" on storage.objects
69	  for select using (
70	    bucket_id = 'project-files'
71	    and exists (
72	      select 1 from public.project_files pf
73	      join public.projects p on p.id = pf.project_id
74	      where pf.storage_path = name and p.owner_user_id = auth.uid()
75	    )
76	  );
77	
78	-- Rewrite the `handle_new_user` trigger so it no longer computes `is_admin`
79	-- from a postgres GUC. The column keeps its default `false` and stops drifting.
80	create or replace function public.handle_new_user()
81	returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public
82	as $$
83	begin
84	  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name)
85	  values (
86	    new.id,
87	    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'
88	  );
89	  return new;
90	end;
91	$$;
92	
93	
94	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
95	-- 3. invoices.hosted_invoice_url -- Stripe-hosted invoicing (gate-3).
96	--    Admin's "Create Stripe Invoice" action will persist this so the portal
97	--    "Pay" button links straight to Stripe's hosted page.
98	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
99	alter table public.invoices
100	  add column if not exists hosted_invoice_url text;
101	
102	
103	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
104	-- 4. Work-order ticketing system (per production-plan §7.1, §7.2).
105	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
106	do $$ begin
107	  create type work_order_service_type as enum (
108	    'logo', 'website_update', 'data_export', 'consulting', 'other'
109	  );
110	exception when duplicate_object then null; end $$;
111	
112	do $$ begin
113	  create type work_order_status as enum (
114	    'open', 'quoted', 'accepted', 'in_progress', 'delivered', 'closed', 'cancelled'
115	  );
116	exception when duplicate_object then null; end $$;
117	
118	do $$ begin
119	  create type work_order_priority as enum ('low', 'normal', 'high');
120	exception when duplicate_object then null; end $$;
121	
122	create table if not exists public.work_orders (
123	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
124	  created_by uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
125	  -- Nullable: clients can submit a request before a project exists for it.
126	  project_id uuid references public.projects(id) on delete set null,
127	  service_type work_order_service_type not null,
128	  title text not null,
129	  description text,
130	  status work_order_status not null default 'open',
131	  priority work_order_priority not null default 'normal',
132	  quoted_amount_cents integer,
133	  quoted_at timestamptz,
134	  -- accepted_at: client confirms quote -> queues admin to create Stripe invoice
135	  accepted_at timestamptz,
136	  invoice_id uuid references public.invoices(id) on delete set null,
137	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
138	  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
139	);
140	
141	create index if not exists work_orders_created_by_idx on public.work_orders(created_by);
142	create index if not exists work_orders_status_idx     on public.work_orders(status);
143	create index if not exists work_orders_project_idx    on public.work_orders(project_id);
144	
145	drop trigger if exists work_orders_updated_at on public.work_orders;
146	create trigger work_orders_updated_at
147	  before update on public.work_orders
148	  for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();
149	
150	create table if not exists public.work_order_attachments (
151	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
152	  work_order_id uuid not null references public.work_orders(id) on delete cascade,
153	  storage_path text not null,
154	  filename text not null,
155	  mime_type text,
156	  size_bytes bigint,
157	  uploaded_at timestamptz not null default now()
158	);
159	
160	create index if not exists work_order_attachments_wo_idx
161	  on public.work_order_attachments(work_order_id);
162	
163	
164	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
165	-- 4b. Work-order RLS.
166	--     Admin path bypasses RLS via `createAdminClient()`. RLS only gates the
167	--     anon/authed client path. Column-level "can only set accepted_at +
168	--     status='accepted'" is enforced in the `acceptWorkOrderQuote` server
169	--     action -- RLS provides defense-in-depth on ownership + status.
170	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
171	alter table public.work_orders            enable row level security;
172	alter table public.work_order_attachments enable row level security;
173	
174	drop policy if exists "wo_select_own"          on public.work_orders;
175	drop policy if exists "wo_insert_own"          on public.work_orders;
176	drop policy if exists "wo_update_accept_quote" on public.work_orders;
177	
178	create policy "wo_select_own" on public.work_orders
179	  for select using (created_by = auth.uid());
180	
181	create policy "wo_insert_own" on public.work_orders
182	  for insert with check (created_by = auth.uid());
183	
184	create policy "wo_update_accept_quote" on public.work_orders
185	  for update using (created_by = auth.uid() and status = 'quoted')
186	  with check (created_by = auth.uid());
187	
188	drop policy if exists "wo_att_select_own" on public.work_order_attachments;
189	drop policy if exists "wo_att_insert_own" on public.work_order_attachments;
190	
191	create policy "wo_att_select_own" on public.work_order_attachments
192	  for select using (
193	    exists (
194	      select 1 from public.work_orders w
195	      where w.id = work_order_attachments.work_order_id
196	        and w.created_by = auth.uid()
197	    )
198	  );
199	
200	create policy "wo_att_insert_own" on public.work_order_attachments
201	  for insert with check (
202	    exists (
203	      select 1 from public.work_orders w
204	      where w.id = work_order_attachments.work_order_id
205	        and w.created_by = auth.uid()
206	    )
207	  );
208	
209	
210	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
211	-- 5. Storage bucket: `work-order-attachments` (private).
212	--    Per production-plan §7.3: 25 MB cap, image/PDF/common-doc MIME allowlist
213	--    enforced in the server action *before* a signed upload URL is issued.
214	--    Admin reads/writes via service-role; RLS gates client read/write to
215	--    objects whose `name` (storage path) belongs to a work order owned by
216	--    the requesting user.
217	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
218	insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public)
219	  values ('work-order-attachments', 'work-order-attachments', false)
220	  on conflict (id) do nothing;
221	
222	drop policy if exists "wo_attachments_storage_select_own" on storage.objects;
223	drop policy if exists "wo_attachments_storage_insert_own" on storage.objects;
224	drop policy if exists "wo_attachments_storage_delete_own" on storage.objects;
225	
226	create policy "wo_attachments_storage_select_own" on storage.objects
227	  for select using (
228	    bucket_id = 'work-order-attachments'
229	    and exists (
230	      select 1 from public.work_order_attachments a
231	      join public.work_orders w on w.id = a.work_order_id
232	      where a.storage_path = name and w.created_by = auth.uid()
233	    )
234	  );
235	
236	create policy "wo_attachments_storage_insert_own" on storage.objects
237	  for insert with check (
238	    bucket_id = 'work-order-attachments'
239	    and exists (
240	      select 1 from public.work_orders w
241	      where w.created_by = auth.uid()
242	        -- New uploads land under <work_order_id>/... by convention; enforce it
243	        -- so a client cannot upload into another user's namespace.
244	        and name like w.id::text || '/%'
245	    )
246	  );
247	
248	create policy "wo_attachments_storage_delete_own" on storage.objects
249	  for delete using (
250	    bucket_id = 'work-order-attachments'
251	    and exists (
252	      select 1 from public.work_order_attachments a
253	      join public.work_orders w on w.id = a.work_order_id
254	      where a.storage_path = name and w.created_by = auth.uid()
255	    )
256	  );

1	-- =============================================================================
2	-- dobeu.net v3 — live schema repair (2026-06-17)
3	-- Fixes drift on Vercel Supabase ipmjokuezeuukhrilduq:
4	--   - profiles.updated_at + trigger
5	--   - profiles.stripe_customer_id + partial unique index (Phase 3)
6	--   - public.projects table (missing while project_files exists)
7	-- Idempotent: safe to re-run.
8	-- =============================================================================
9	
10	create extension if not exists "uuid-ossp";
11	
12	-- =============================================================================
13	-- updated_at helper (from initial schema)
14	-- =============================================================================
15	create or replace function public.set_updated_at()
16	returns trigger language plpgsql as $$
17	begin
18	  new.updated_at = now();
19	  return new;
20	end;
21	$$;
22	
23	-- =============================================================================
24	-- profiles.updated_at
25	-- =============================================================================
26	alter table public.profiles
27	  add column if not exists updated_at timestamptz not null default now();
28	
29	drop trigger if exists profiles_updated_at on public.profiles;
30	create trigger profiles_updated_at before update on public.profiles
31	  for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();
32	
33	-- =============================================================================
34	-- Phase 3: profiles.stripe_customer_id (from 20260615000000)
35	-- =============================================================================
36	alter table public.profiles
37	  add column if not exists stripe_customer_id text;
38	
39	create unique index if not exists profiles_stripe_customer_id_unique
40	  on public.profiles(stripe_customer_id)
41	  where stripe_customer_id is not null;
42	
43	comment on column public.profiles.stripe_customer_id is
44	  'Stripe customer ID (cus_*); lazy-created on first invoice issued.';
45	
46	-- =============================================================================
47	-- projects (from 20260521000000_initial_schema.sql)
48	-- NO projects_admin_all — per 20260605000000 phase1 reconciliation
49	-- =============================================================================
50	do $$ begin
51	  create type project_status as enum ('proposed', 'active', 'delivered', 'closed');
52	exception when duplicate_object then null; end $$;
53	
54	create table if not exists public.projects (
55	  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
56	  owner_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
57	  title text not null,
58	  description text,
59	  status project_status not null default 'proposed',
60	  started_at timestamptz,
61	  delivered_at timestamptz,
62	  total_cents integer not null default 0,
63	  stripe_link text,
64	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
65	  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
66	);
67	
68	create index if not exists projects_owner_idx on public.projects(owner_user_id);
69	create index if not exists projects_status_idx on public.projects(status);
70	
71	alter table public.projects enable row level security;
72	
73	drop policy if exists "projects_select_own" on public.projects;
74	create policy "projects_select_own" on public.projects
75	  for select using (owner_user_id = auth.uid());
76	
77	drop trigger if exists projects_updated_at on public.projects;
78	create trigger projects_updated_at before update on public.projects
79	  for each row execute function public.set_updated_at();
80	
81	-- =============================================================================
82	-- project_files FK repair — add only when both tables exist, FK absent, no orphans
83	-- =============================================================================
84	do $$
85	begin
86	  if exists (
87	    select 1 from information_schema.tables
88	    where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'project_files'
89	  ) and exists (
90	    select 1 from information_schema.tables
91	    where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'projects'
92	  ) then
93	    if not exists (
94	      select 1
95	      from information_schema.table_constraints tc
96	      join information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
97	        on tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
98	        and tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
99	      join information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu
100	        on ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
101	        and ccu.table_schema = tc.table_schema
102	      where tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
103	        and tc.table_schema = 'public'
104	        and tc.table_name = 'project_files'
105	        and kcu.column_name = 'project_id'
106	        and ccu.table_name = 'projects'
107	    ) then
108	      if not exists (
109	        select 1
110	        from public.project_files pf
111	        left join public.projects p on p.id = pf.project_id
112	        where p.id is null
113	      ) then
114	        alter table public.project_files
115	          add constraint project_files_project_id_fkey
116	          foreign key (project_id) references public.projects(id) on delete cascade;
117	      end if;
118	    end if;
119	  end if;
120	end $$;

1	-- =============================================================================
2	-- dobeu.net v3 — work-order / invoice linkage (Phase 3 close-out)
3	-- =============================================================================
4	-- Closes the P0 revenue gap: lets an admin issue a Stripe invoice for an
5	-- accepted work order that has NO project, while keeping the invoice visible
6	-- to (and payable by) the owning client under RLS.
7	--
8	-- Idempotent: every change is guarded (`if not exists` / `do $$`).
9	--
10	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
11	-- CENTRAL TYPE-RECONCILIATION NOTES (orchestrator must regenerate
12	-- lib/database.types.ts — `pnpm db:types`). EXACT changes:
13	--
14	--   public.invoices
15	--     - project_id : uuid NOT NULL  ->  uuid NULL          (now nullable)
16	--     - user_id    : NEW column     uuid NULL references auth.users(id)
17	--
18	--   public.work_orders
19	--     - in_progress_at : NEW column timestamptz NULL
20	--     - delivered_at   : NEW column timestamptz NULL
21	--     - closed_at      : NEW column timestamptz NULL
22	--     - cancelled_at   : NEW column timestamptz NULL
23	--
24	-- No other tables touched.
25	-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
26	
27	-- =============================================================================
28	-- 1. invoices: allow project-less invoices + a direct owner column for RLS.
29	--    Today an invoice is owned solely via project_id -> projects.owner_user_id.
30	--    A project-less work-order invoice would therefore be invisible to the
31	--    client. Adding invoices.user_id (the work order's created_by) gives RLS a
32	--    direct ownership path and is the lowest-blast-radius change: existing
33	--    project-scoped invoices keep working unchanged.
34	-- =============================================================================
35	alter table public.invoices
36	  alter column project_id drop not null;
37	
38	alter table public.invoices
39	  add column if not exists user_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete cascade;
40	
41	create index if not exists invoices_user_idx on public.invoices(user_id);
42	
43	comment on column public.invoices.user_id is
44	  'Direct owner (auth.users.id). Set for work-order invoices that may have a NULL project_id so RLS can scope client reads without a project. Project-scoped invoices may leave this NULL and rely on project_id -> projects.owner_user_id.';
45	
46	-- Backfill user_id for existing project-scoped rows (best-effort; not required
47	-- for correctness, but keeps the ownership signal consistent going forward).
48	update public.invoices i
49	  set user_id = p.owner_user_id
50	  from public.projects p
51	  where i.project_id = p.id
52	    and i.user_id is null;
53	
54	-- =============================================================================
55	-- 2. invoices RLS: extend client read to ALSO match user_id = auth.uid().
56	--    Leave invoices_admin_all untouched (admin reads go through service-role
57	--    and bypass RLS; that policy still references the dropped is_admin column

-- to (and payable by) the owning client under RLS.

--     - user_id    : NEW column     uuid NULL references auth.users(id)
--
--   public.work_orders
--     - in_progress_at : NEW column timestamptz NULL
--     - delivered_at   : NEW column timestamptz NULL
--     - closed_at      : NEW column timestamptz NULL
--     - cancelled_at   : NEW column timestamptz NULL

--    direct ownership path and is the lowest-blast-radius change: existing
--    project-scoped invoices keep working unchanged.
-- =============================================================================

  alter column project_id drop not null;

alter table public.invoices
  add column if not exists user_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete cascade;

create index if not exists invoices_user_idx on public.invoices(user_id);

comment on column public.invoices.user_id is

  for select using (

    or exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = invoices.project_id and p.owner_user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

--    in_progress / delivered / closed / cancelled milestones with real times.
-- =============================================================================
alter table public.work_orders
  add column if not exists in_progress_at timestamptz;

alter table public.work_orders
  add column if not exists delivered_at timestamptz;

alter table public.work_orders
  add column if not exists closed_at timestamptz;

alter table public.work_orders
  add column if not exists cancelled_at timestamptz;

content.subject: Phase 0: PR triage
content.description: Merge PR #182 (fixes /api/github-repo SSRF + rate-limit + green test suite, supersedes #178) into main. Close PR #178 as superseded, referencing #182. Leave #177/#179 for user triage (cosmetic, unrelated).

content.subject: Phase 1: Unify Next.js config (CSP fix)
content.description: Merge images.remotePatterns from next.config.js (avatars.githubusercontent.com, github.com) into next.config.ts. Delete next.config.js. Verify pnpm build has no dual-config warning. This unblocks CSP/security headers shipping to production.

content.subject: Phase 1: RLS WITH CHECK migration
content.description: New Supabase migration adding WITH CHECK ((select auth.uid()) = id) to profiles_update_own policy. Audit other UPDATE policies (work_orders client-accept path, etc.) for the same USING-without-WITH-CHECK gap and fix them too.

content.subject: Phase 1: Docs alignment
content.description: Fix .env.example to use NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_* names instead of legacy NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_*. Correct README TODOs that are actually shipped (Stripe webhook, admin CRUD).

content.subject: Phase 2: Dispatch parallel audit tracks
content.description: Dispatch parallel research agents for: 2a backend architecture review, 2b security vulnerability check (RLS per-table, webhook HMAC coverage, rate-limit coverage, secrets), 2c cost optimization (Vercel/Supabase/third-party API), 2d performance evaluation (mobile Lighthouse gap, bundle size, DB queries), 2e code simplification audit (knip/ts-prune, duplication, file-size), 2f UX gap analysis (portal/admin/landing missing states, a11y, dead-end flows). Each returns structured findings with file:line references and severity.

content.subject: Phase 2: Synthesize audit backlog + fix Critical/High
content.description: Merge the 5 audit tracks' findings into one ranked backlog (Critical/High/Medium/Low). Fix Critical/High items inline on this branch. Document Medium/Low as a follow-up list rather than expanding scope further.

content.subject: Phase 3: UI function test pass
content.description: Run pnpm verify (type-check + lint + test:ci + build:strict) and pnpm test:e2e (smoke.spec.ts, tickets.spec.ts). Start pnpm dev and manually drive: lead form submit, Calendly/Typeform lightbox tabs, cookie consent banner, nav + mobile sticky CTA, theme toggle, new automation-tiles interaction, and the new automations page end-to-end.

content.subject: Phase 4: Remove personal photo from Hero
content.description: Remove the <Image src={FOUNDER.avatar}> block and availability-dot overlay from components/landing/Hero.tsx (~lines 306-327). Rework the avatar column layout (replace with DobeuMark in glass treatment, or rebalance hero to single centered layout) as part of the Phase 6 redesign so it isn't done twice.

content.subject: Phase 5: Build glassmorphic automations landing page
content.description: New route app/automations/page.tsx. Glass-tile grid (extend .glass utility) with 5-6 pain-point cards that fade from hook copy ("Aren't sure where to begin...") to the automation/example that solves it, auto-cycling via useInView-paused interval, respecting prefers-reduced-motion. Content sourced from lib/jeremy-data.ts GTM_PILLARS. CTAs route into existing LightboxProvider.

content.subject: Phase 6: Facelift main page
content.description: Update Hero.tsx copy/layout per Phase 4's photo-removal decision, refresh visual treatment (glass panels, updated gradient/mesh background) to match the new automations page's aesthetic. Add a link/section on the homepage into /automations. Re-run Lighthouse informally; don't regress the Phase 1 CSP fix.

content.subject: Phase 7: Final verification + wrap-up
content.description: pnpm verify green, pnpm test:e2e green. Update STATUS.md/PLAN.md to reflect what shipped this sprint vs still operator-gated. Summarize remaining operator checklist (Vercel env vars, GitHub security settings, Twilio, Stripe/Resend dashboard verification) plus the audit's Medium/Low backlog.

# dobeu.net v3

Next.js 15 marketing landing + minimal client portal for [Dobeu Tech Solutions](https://dobeu.net).
Built against the [Dobeu Design System v2](../dobeu-eco/figma-design/dobeu-design-system).

```
Stack:        Next.js 15 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind · shadcn/ui · Framer Motion
Backend:      Supabase (Auth + Postgres + Storage + RLS)
Booking:      Apollo Meetings (with custom Google-Calendar fallback)
Lead capture: Apollo upsert + Typeform + Supabase + Resend confirmation
Analytics:    PostHog + Mixpanel + GA4 + GTM (consent-gated)
Payments:     Stripe Checkout + webhooks → Supabase
Hosting:      Vercel
```

Read [`BRAINSTORM.md`](./BRAINSTORM.md) and [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) before making changes — they're the
source of truth for scope, decisions, and verification gates.

---

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. Install
pnpm install

# 2. Copy env template, then fill in real values
cp .env.example .env.local

# 3. Start a local Supabase (or point at remote)

# dobeu.net v3

Next.js 15 marketing landing + minimal client portal for [Dobeu Tech Solutions](https://dobeu.net).
Built against the [Dobeu Design System v2](../dobeu-eco/figma-design/dobeu-design-system).

```
Stack:        Next.js 15 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind · shadcn/ui · Framer Motion
Backend:      Supabase (Auth + Postgres + Storage + RLS)
Booking:      Apollo Meetings (with custom Google-Calendar fallback)
Lead capture: Apollo upsert + Typeform + Supabase + Resend confirmation
Analytics:    PostHog + Mixpanel + GA4 + GTM (consent-gated)
Payments:     Stripe Checkout + webhooks → Supabase
Hosting:      Vercel
```

Read [`BRAINSTORM.md`](./BRAINSTORM.md) and [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) before making changes — they're the
source of truth for scope, decisions, and verification gates.

---

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. Install
pnpm install

# 2. Copy env template, then fill in real values
cp .env.example .env.local

# 3. Start a local Supabase (or point at remote)
pnpm supabase start            # local Postgres + Auth via Docker
pnpm supabase db push          # apply migrations
pnpm db:types                  # regenerate lib/database.types.ts

# 4. Run dev server
pnpm dev                       # → http://localhost:3000
```

Required environment variables (see `.env.example` for the full list):

| Variable | Required for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Everything | Auto-provisioned by the Vercel Marketplace Supabase integration. The URL alias must be added manually because Vercel ships it server-only by default. |
| `VERCEL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Lead API, webhooks, admin reads | **Server only** — never expose. Auto-provisioned by the Marketplace integration. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | `/admin` gating | Comma-separated. v1 default: `jeremyw@dobeu.net` |
| `APOLLO_API_KEY` | Lead capture, contact upsert | Server only |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APOLLO_MEETINGS_URL` | Booking lightbox | Apollo Meetings hosted URL. Leave blank for fallback flow |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_TYPEFORM_FORM_ID` | "Tell me more" tab | Embed id of the qualified intake form |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` / `_HOST` | Product analytics | https://us.i.posthog.com (default) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MIXPANEL_TOKEN` | Funnel analytics | |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID` | Acquisition | `G-XXXXXXX` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID` | Tag orchestration | `GTM-XXXXXX` |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | Invoices | |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | `/api/webhooks/stripe` | |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` / `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` / `RESEND_REPLY_TO` | Transactional email | |

---

## Project layout

```
new-dobeu-net/
├─ app/
│  ├─ (root)                 ─ marketing landing page
│  ├─ login/                 ─ magic-link auth
│  ├─ auth/callback/         ─ Supabase OAuth callback
│  ├─ portal/                ─ authenticated client portal
│  │  ├─ projects/[id]/      ─ project detail + files + invoices
│  │  ├─ files/              ─ flat file browser
│  │  ├─ invoices/           ─ list + Stripe pay links
│  │  ├─ messages/           ─ thread to Jeremy
│  │  └─ settings/
│  ├─ admin/                 ─ ADMIN_EMAILS gated
│  ├─ api/
│  │  └─ lead/               ─ POST: Supabase + Apollo + Resend fan-out
│  ├─ sitemap.ts
│  ├─ robots.ts
│  ├─ opengraph-image.tsx    ─ dynamic OG card
│  └─ globals.css            ─ Dobeu DS v2 tokens
├─ components/
│  ├─ brand/                 ─ DobeuMark SVG component
│  ├─ landing/               ─ Hero, Services, Lightbox, FAQ, etc.
│  ├─ portal/                ─ LogoutButton, …
│  ├─ ui/                    ─ shadcn primitives (button, dialog, tabs, …)
│  ├─ theme-provider.tsx
│  ├─ theme-toggle.tsx       ─ Light / Dark / System
│  └─ analytics-provider.tsx ─ PostHog/Mixpanel/GA4/GTM + consent
├─ lib/
│  ├─ supabase/              ─ client/server/middleware/admin
│  ├─ analytics.ts           ─ unified fan-out
│  ├─ apollo.ts              ─ Apollo API wrapper
│  ├─ database.types.ts      ─ pnpm db:types regenerates
│  └─ utils.ts
├─ supabase/
│  └─ migrations/            ─ initial schema with RLS
├─ docs/
│  ├─ DEPLOYMENT.md          ─ Vercel + DNS cutover steps
│  └─ tracking-plan.md       ─ every analytics event documented
├─ public/
│  └─ llms.txt               ─ AI-citation metadata
├─ BRAINSTORM.md             ─ scope + decisions
├─ PLAN.md                   ─ phased implementation plan (approved)
└─ vercel.json
```

---

## Routes

| Route | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | public | Marketing landing with hero, services, lightbox CTA, FAQ |
| `/login` | public | Magic-link auth via Supabase |
| `/auth/callback` | public | OAuth callback handler |
| `/portal` | required | Client dashboard |
| `/portal/projects` | required | Project list |
| `/portal/projects/[id]` | required | Project detail + files + invoices |
| `/portal/files` | required | Flat file browser with signed-URL downloads |
| `/portal/invoices` | required | Invoice list + Stripe pay links |
| `/portal/messages` | required | Thread with admin |
| `/portal/settings` | required | Profile |
| `/admin` | admin only | Overview: leads, bookings, MRR, users |
| `/admin/leads` | admin only | Apollo-enriched lead table (TODO) |
| `/admin/bookings` | admin only | Upcoming + past bookings (TODO) |
| `/admin/users` | admin only | User list, edit, send invoice (TODO) |
| `/api/lead` | public POST | Lead capture: Supabase + Apollo + Resend fan-out |
| `/api/webhooks/stripe` | Stripe sig | Invoice status sync (TODO) |

Routes marked `(TODO)` are scaffolded in `PLAN.md` Phase 2C but need their data layer wired
before they render real data.

---

## Themes

`next-themes` with `attribute="class"`, `defaultTheme="system"`. Three modes:

- **Light** — paper-50 surface, ink-900 text, indigo+amber accents
- **Dark** — ink-900 surface, paper-50 text, indigo-400 + amber accents
- **System** — follows OS preference

Theme toggle lives in the nav and portal sidebar.

---

## Verification

Run before any merge to `main`:

```bash
pnpm type-check && pnpm lint && pnpm test:ci && pnpm build
```

Browser walkthrough is in [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) §Phase 4. Lighthouse targets:
Perf ≥90 / A11y ≥95 / BP ≥90 / SEO ≥95 (mobile and desktop).

---

## License

Proprietary — © Dobeu Tech Solutions LLC.

Next.js 15 marketing landing + minimal client portal for [Dobeu Tech Solutions](https://dobeu.net).
Built against the [Dobeu Design System v2](../dobeu-eco/figma-design/dobeu-design-system).

```
Stack:        Next.js 15 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind · shadcn/ui · Framer Motion
Backend:      Supabase (Auth + Postgres + Storage + RLS)
Booking:      Apollo Meetings (with custom Google-Calendar fallback)
Lead capture: Apollo upsert + Typeform + Supabase + Resend confirmation
Analytics:    PostHog + Mixpanel + GA4 + GTM (consent-gated)
Payments:     Stripe Checkout + webhooks → Supabase
Hosting:      Vercel
```

Read [`BRAINSTORM.md`](./BRAINSTORM.md) and [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) before making changes — they're the
source of truth for scope, decisions, and verification gates.

---

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. Install
pnpm install



C:\Users\JeremyWilliamsepos
ew-dobeu-net>
C:\Users\JeremyWilliamsepos
ew-dobeu-net> 2. Copy env template, then fill in real values
cp .env.example .env.local

# 3. Start a local Supabase (or point at remote)
pnpm supabase start            # local Postgres + Auth via Docker
pnpm supabase db push          # apply migrations
pnpm db:types                  # regenerate lib/database.types.ts

# 4. Run dev server
pnpm dev                       # → http://localhost:3000
```

Required environment variables (see `.env.example` for the full list):

| Variable | Required for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Everything | Auto-provisioned by the Vercel Marketplace Supabase integration. The URL alias must be added manually because Vercel ships it server-only by default. |
| `VERCEL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Lead API, webhooks, admin reads | **Server only** — never expose. Auto-provisioned by the Marketplace integration. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | `/admin` gating | Comma-separated. v1 default: `jeremyw@dobeu.net` |
| `APOLLO_API_KEY` | Lead capture, contact upsert | Server only |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APOLLO_MEETINGS_URL` | Booking lightbox | Apollo Meetings hosted URL. Leave blank for fallback flow |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_TYPEFORM_FORM_ID` | "Tell me more" tab | Embed id of the qualified intake form |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` / `_HOST` | Product analytics | https://us.i.posthog.com (default) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MIXPANEL_TOKEN` | Funnel analytics | |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID` | Acquisition | `G-XXXXXXX` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID` | Tag orchestration | `GTM-XXXXXX` |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | Invoices | |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | `/api/webhooks/stripe` | |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` / `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` / `RESEND_REPLY_TO` | Transactional email | |

## Themes

`next-themes` with `attribute="class"`, `defaultTheme="system"`. Three modes:

- **Light** — paper-50 surface, ink-900 text, indigo+amber accents
- **Dark** — ink-900 surface, paper-50 text, indigo-400 + amber accents
- **System** — follows OS preference

Theme toggle lives in the nav and portal sidebar.

---

## Verification

Run before any merge to `main`:

```bash
pnpm type-check && pnpm lint && pnpm test:ci && pnpm build
```

Browser walkthrough is in [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) §Phase 4. Lighthouse targets:
Perf ≥90 / A11y ≥95 / BP ≥90 / SEO ≥95 (mobile and desktop).

Next.js 15 marketing landing + minimal client portal for [Dobeu Tech Solutions](https://dobeu.net).
Built against the [Dobeu Design System v2](../dobeu-eco/figma-design/dobeu-design-system).

```
Stack:        Next.js 15 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind · shadcn/ui · Framer Motion
Backend:      Supabase (Auth + Postgres + Storage + RLS)
Booking:      Apollo Meetings (with custom Google-Calendar fallback)
Lead capture: Apollo upsert + Typeform + Supabase + Resend confirmation
Analytics:    PostHog + Mixpanel + GA4 + GTM (consent-gated)
Payments:     Stripe Checkout + webhooks → Supabase
Hosting:      Vercel
```

Read [`BRAINSTORM.md`](./BRAINSTORM.md) and [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) before making changes — they're the
source of truth for scope, decisions, and verification gates.

---

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. Install
pnpm install

# 2. Copy env template, then fill in real values
cp .env.example .env.local

# 3. Start a local Supabase (or point at remote)
pnpm supabase start            # local Postgres + Auth via Docker
pnpm supabase db push          # apply migrations
pnpm db:types                  # regenerate lib/database.types.ts

# 4. Run dev server
pnpm dev                       # → http://localhost:3000
```

Required environment variables (see `.env.example` for the full list):

| Variable | Required for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Everything | Auto-provisioned by the Vercel Marketplace Supabase integration. The URL alias must be added manually because Vercel ships it server-only by default. |
| `VERCEL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Lead API, webhooks, admin reads | **Server only** — never expose. Auto-provisioned by the Marketplace integration. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | `/admin` gating | Comma-separated. v1 default: `jeremyw@dobeu.net` |
| `APOLLO_API_KEY` | Lead capture, contact upsert | Server only |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APOLLO_MEETINGS_URL` | Booking lightbox | Apollo Meetings hosted URL. Leave blank for fallback flow |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_TYPEFORM_FORM_ID` | "Tell me more" tab | Embed id of the qualified intake form |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` / `_HOST` | Product analytics | https://us.i.posthog.com (default) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MIXPANEL_TOKEN` | Funnel analytics | |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID` | Acquisition | `G-XXXXXXX` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID` | Tag orchestration | `GTM-XXXXXX` |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | Invoices | |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | `/api/webhooks/stripe` | |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` / `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` / `RESEND_REPLY_TO` | Transactional email | |

| `/api/agent` | admin only | Embedded Claude Agent SDK surface |","originalFile":"# dobeu.net v3

Next.js 15 marketing landing + minimal client portal for [Dobeu Tech Solutions](https://dobeu.net).
Built against the [Dobeu Design System v2](../dobeu-eco/figma-design/dobeu-design-system).

```
Stack:        Next.js 15 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind · shadcn/ui · Framer Motion
Backend:      Supabase (Auth + Postgres + Storage + RLS)
Booking:      Apollo Meetings (with custom Google-Calendar fallback)
Lead capture: Apollo upsert + Typeform + Supabase + Resend confirmation
Analytics:    PostHog + Mixpanel + GA4 + GTM (consent-gated)
Payments:     Stripe Checkout + webhooks → Supabase
Hosting:      Vercel
```

Read [`BRAINSTORM.md`](./BRAINSTORM.md) and [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) before making changes — they're the
source of truth for scope, decisions, and verification gates.

---

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. Install
pnpm install

# 2. Copy env template, then fill in real values
cp .env.example .env.local

# 3. Start a local Supabase (or point at remote)
pnpm supabase start            # local Postgres + Auth via Docker
pnpm supabase db push          # apply migrations
pnpm db:types                  # regenerate lib/database.types.ts

# 4. Run dev server
pnpm dev                       # → http://localhost:3000
```

Required environment variables (see `.env.example` for the full list):

| Variable | Required for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Everything | Auto-provisioned by the Vercel Marketplace Supabase integration. The URL alias must be added manually because Vercel ships it server-only by default. |
| `VERCEL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Lead API, webhooks, admin reads | **Server only** — never expose. Auto-provisioned by the Marketplace integration. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | `/admin` gating | Comma-separated. v1 default: `jeremyw@dobeu.net` |
| `APOLLO_API_KEY` | Lead capture, contact upsert | Server only |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APOLLO_MEETINGS_URL` | Booking lightbox | Apollo Meetings hosted URL. Leave blank for fallback flow |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_TYPEFORM_FORM_ID` | "Tell me more" tab | Embed id of the qualified intake form |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` / `_HOST` | Product analytics | https://us.i.posthog.com (default) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MIXPANEL_TOKEN` | Funnel analytics | |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID` | Acquisition | `G-XXXXXXX` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID` | Tag orchestration | `GTM-XXXXXX` |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | Invoices | |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | `/api/webhooks/stripe` | |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` / `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` / `RESEND_REPLY_TO` | Transactional email | |

---

## Project layout

```
new-dobeu-net/
├─ app/
│  ├─ (root)                 ─ marketing landing page
│  ├─ login/                 ─ magic-link auth
│  ├─ auth/callback/         ─ Supabase OAuth callback
│  ├─ portal/                ─ authenticated client portal
│  │  ├─ projects/[id]/      ─ project detail + files + invoices
│  │  ├─ files/              ─ flat file browser
│  │  ├─ invoices/           ─ list + Stripe pay links
│  │  ├─ messages/           ─ thread to Jeremy
│  │  └─ settings/
│  ├─ admin/                 ─ ADMIN_EMAILS gated
│  ├─ api/
│  │  └─ lead/               ─ POST: Supabase + Apollo + Resend fan-out
│  ├─ sitemap.ts
│  ├─ robots.ts
│  ├─ opengraph-image.tsx    ─ dynamic OG card
│  └─ globals.css            ─ Dobeu DS v2 tokens
├─ components/

│  ├─ landing/               ─ Hero, Services, Lightbox, FAQ, etc.
│  ├─ portal/                ─ LogoutButton, …
│  ├─ ui/                    ─ shadcn primitives (button, dialog, tabs, …)
│  ├─ theme-provider.tsx
│  ├─ theme-toggle.tsx       ─ Light / Dark / System
│  └─ analytics-provider.tsx ─ PostHog/Mixpanel/GA4/GTM + consent
├─ lib/
│  ├─ supabase/              ─ client/server/middleware/admin
│  ├─ analytics.ts           ─ unified fan-out
│  ├─ apollo.ts              ─ Apollo API wrapper
│  ├─ database.types.ts      ─ pnpm db:types regenerates
│  └─ utils.ts
├─ supabase/
│  └─ migrations/            ─ initial schema with RLS
├─ docs/
│  ├─ DEPLOYMENT.md          ─ Vercel + DNS cutover steps
│  └─ tracking-plan.md       ─ every analytics event documented
├─ public/
│  └─ llms.txt               ─ AI-citation metadata
├─ BRAINSTORM.md             ─ scope + decisions
├─ PLAN.md                   ─ phased implementation plan (approved)
└─ vercel.json
```

before they render real data.

---

## Themes

`next-themes` with `attribute="class"`, `defaultTheme="system"`. Three modes:

- **Light** — paper-50 surface, ink-900 text, indigo+amber accents
- **Dark** — ink-900 surface, paper-50 text, indigo-400 + amber accents
- **System** — follows OS preference

Theme toggle lives in the nav and portal sidebar.

---

## Verification

Run before any merge to `main`:

```bash
pnpm type-check && pnpm lint && pnpm test:ci && pnpm build
```

Browser walkthrough is in [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) §Phase 4. Lighthouse targets:
Perf ≥90 / A11y ≥95 / BP ≥90 / SEO ≥95 (mobile and desktop).

Next.js 15 marketing landing + minimal client portal for [Dobeu Tech Solutions](https://dobeu.net).
Built against the [Dobeu Design System v2](../dobeu-eco/figma-design/dobeu-design-system).

```
Stack:        Next.js 15 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind · shadcn/ui · Framer Motion
Backend:      Supabase (Auth + Postgres + Storage + RLS)
Booking:      Apollo Meetings (with custom Google-Calendar fallback)
Lead capture: Apollo upsert + Typeform + Supabase + Resend confirmation
Analytics:    PostHog + Mixpanel + GA4 + GTM (consent-gated)
Payments:     Stripe Checkout + webhooks → Supabase
Hosting:      Vercel
```

Read [`BRAINSTORM.md`](./BRAINSTORM.md) and [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) before making changes — they're the
source of truth for scope, decisions, and verification gates.

---

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. Install
pnpm install

# 2. Copy env template, then fill in real values
cp .env.example .env.local

# 3. Start a local Supabase (or point at remote)
pnpm supabase start            # local Postgres + Auth via Docker
pnpm supabase db push          # apply migrations
pnpm db:types                  # regenerate lib/database.types.ts

# 4. Run dev server
pnpm dev                       # → http://localhost:3000
```

Required environment variables (see `.env.example` for the full list):

| Variable | Required for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Everything | Auto-provisioned by the Vercel Marketplace Supabase integration. The URL alias must be added manually because Vercel ships it server-only by default. |
| `VERCEL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Lead API, webhooks, admin reads | **Server only** — never expose. Auto-provisioned by the Marketplace integration. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | `/admin` gating | Comma-separated. v1 default: `jeremyw@dobeu.net` |
| `APOLLO_API_KEY` | Lead capture, contact upsert | Server only |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APOLLO_MEETINGS_URL` | Booking lightbox | Apollo Meetings hosted URL. Leave blank for fallback flow |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_TYPEFORM_FORM_ID` | "Tell me more" tab | Embed id of the qualified intake form |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` / `_HOST` | Product analytics | https://us.i.posthog.com (default) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MIXPANEL_TOKEN` | Funnel analytics | |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID` | Acquisition | `G-XXXXXXX` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID` | Tag orchestration | `GTM-XXXXXX` |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | Invoices | |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | `/api/webhooks/stripe` | |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` / `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` / `RESEND_REPLY_TO` | Transactional email | |

---

## Themes

`next-themes` with `attribute="class"`, `defaultTheme="system"`. Three modes:

- **Light** — paper-50 surface, ink-900 text, indigo+amber accents
- **Dark** — ink-900 surface, paper-50 text, indigo-400 + amber accents
- **System** — follows OS preference

Theme toggle lives in the nav and portal sidebar.

---

## Verification

Run before any merge to `main`:

```bash
pnpm type-check && pnpm lint && pnpm test:ci && pnpm build
```

Browser walkthrough is in [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) §Phase 4. Lighthouse targets:
Perf ≥90 / A11y ≥95 / BP ≥90 / SEO ≥95 (mobile and desktop).

Next.js 15 marketing landing + minimal client portal for [Dobeu Tech Solutions](https://dobeu.net).
Built against the [Dobeu Design System v2](../dobeu-eco/figma-design/dobeu-design-system).

```
Stack:        Next.js 15 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind · shadcn/ui · Framer Motion
Backend:      Supabase (Auth + Postgres + Storage + RLS)
Booking:      Apollo Meetings (with custom Google-Calendar fallback)
Lead capture: Apollo upsert + Typeform + Supabase + Resend confirmation
Analytics:    PostHog + Mixpanel + GA4 + GTM (consent-gated)
Payments:     Stripe Checkout + webhooks → Supabase
Hosting:      Vercel
```

Read [`BRAINSTORM.md`](./BRAINSTORM.md) and [`PLAN.md`](./PLAN.md) before making changes — they're the
source of truth for scope, decisions, and verification gates.

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. Install
pnpm install

# 2. Copy env template, then fill in real values
cp .env.example .env.local

# 3. Start a local Supabase (or point at remote)
pnpm supabase start            # local Postgres + Auth via Docker
pnpm supabase db push          # apply migrations
pnpm db:types                  # regenerate lib/database.types.ts

# 4. Run dev server
pnpm dev                       # → http://localhost:3000
```

Required environment variables (see `.env.example` for the full list):

| Variable | Required for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Everything | Auto-provisioned by the Vercel Marketplace Supabase integration. The URL alias must be added manually because Vercel ships it server-only by default. |
| `VERCEL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Lead API, webhooks, admin reads | **Server only** — never expose. Auto-provisioned by the Marketplace integration. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | `/admin` gating | Comma-separated. v1 default: `jeremyw@dobeu.net` |
| `APOLLO_API_KEY` | Lead capture, contact upsert | Server only |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APOLLO_MEETINGS_URL` | Booking lightbox | Apollo Meetings hosted URL. Leave blank for fallback flow |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_TYPEFORM_FORM_ID` | "Tell me more" tab | Embed id of the qualified intake form |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` / `_HOST` | Product analytics | https://us.i.posthog.com (default) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MIXPANEL_TOKEN` | Funnel analytics | |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID` | Acquisition | `G-XXXXXXX` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID` | Tag orchestration | `GTM-XXXXXX` |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | Invoices | |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | `/api/webhooks/stripe` | |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` / `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` / `RESEND_REPLY_TO` | Transactional email | |

fix(security): profiles RLS WITH CHECK + docs alignment

  auth.uid()) = id) in addition to USING, closing an ownership-
  reassignment gap (client could otherwise UPDATE their own row's id).
  Audited other UPDATE policies (wo_update_accept_quote) — already
  correct, no other gaps found.
- README: removed false (TODO) markers on /admin/leads, /admin/bookings,
  /admin/users, /api/webhooks/stripe (all shipped and verified non-stub),
  dropped the stale /portal/messages route (removed when messages table
  was dropped in favor of Intercom), added missing shipped routes
  (tickets, admin invoices/projects/analytics, legal pages, /repos,
  webhook endpoints).
EOF

input.description: Backend architecture review
input.name: audit-architecture
input.prompt:
You are reviewing the backend architecture of `dobeu.net v3`, a Next.js 15 App Router marketing site + client portal + admin dashboard at C:\Users\JeremyWilliams\repos\new-dobeu-net, on branch `feature/hardening-audit-and-landing-refresh`. This is a RESEARCH task — read and analyze only, do not write or edit any files.

Start by reading CLAUDE.md in the repo root — it documents the full architecture (three-surface app, Supabase client patterns, lead pipeline, Stripe invoicing, server-action layer, embedded agent surface, the two-Vercel-service split with an OCI container function). Use it as your map, then verify against the actual code rather than trusting it blindly.

Review specifically:
1. `lib/actions/*.ts` — the server-action layer (auth.ts, work-orders.ts, projects.ts, invoices.ts, profile.ts, files.ts, users.ts). Check: consistency of the `{ok,data}|{ok,error}` discriminated-result pattern, whether `requireAdmin()`/`requireUser()` guards are used everywhere they should be, whether any action does DB writes without going through the shared guards.
2. `lib/supabase/{client,server,middleware}.ts` — the three-client pattern (browser, cookie-bound server client, service-role admin client). Check for any place `createAdminClient()` (service role, bypasses RLS) is used where the cookie-bound client would be more appropriate (principle of least privilege), and vice versa (RLS not being relied on where it should be).
3. Webhook handlers: `app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts`, `app/api/webhooks/calendly/route.ts`, `app/api/typeform/webhook/route.ts` — signature verification presence, idempotency/dedup handling, runtime declarations (nodejs vs edge, and whether that's correct per CLAUDE.md's documented policy).
4. `lib/leads.ts` `processLead()` fan-out — is the "best-effort, non-fatal per step" design actually followed in every entry point that calls it?
5. `containers/function/` (the OCI container service) — is this pulling its weight, or is it dead-weight complexity relative to what it does today (per CLAUDE.md it's described as "a scaffold/proof-of-concept... not yet a product surface")? Give an honest assessment of whether it should be simplified, removed, or is fine to keep as-is.
6. `lib/agent/` embedded agent surface — check it degrades gracefully as documented, and that `app/api/agent/route.ts` truly never accepts client-supplied `permissionMode: "bypassPermissions"`.

Do NOT re-flag things already known to be fixed or already tracked in PLAN.md: CSP config unification (done), /api/github-repo SSRF+rate-limit (done, PR #182), profiles RLS WITH CHECK (done, this session). Do NOT re-list PLAN.md Part 2's already-known operator-gated items (missing Vercel env vars, GitHub security settings, Twilio, Stripe/Resend dashboard verification) as new findings — those are already tracked, skip them entirely.

Report back (as your final message, plain text is fine, no need for a document): a ranked list of findings, each with file:line, a one-sentence description of the architectural issue, severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low), and a one-sentence fix recommendation. input.prompt:
You are running a security audit of `dobeu.net v3`, a Next.js 15 + Supabase + Vercel + Stripe app at C:\Users\JeremyWilliams\repos\new-dobeu-net, on branch `feature/hardening-audit-and-landing-refresh`. This is a RESEARCH task — read and analyze only, do not write or edit any files.

Read CLAUDE.md in the repo root first for architecture context (three-surface app, three Supabase clients, RLS-per-table, webhook entry points, env var map).

Already fixed / already known — do NOT re-flag these:
- CSP/security headers: `next.config.js` was deleted, `next.config.ts` is now the sole config and ships full CSP/HSTS/X-Frame-Options/etc. Verified via clean `pnpm build`.
- `/api/github-repo` SSRF + missing rate-limit: fixed in merged PR #182 (strict owner/repo segment validation + per-IP rate limit).
- `profiles_update_own` RLS policy missing `WITH CHECK`: fixed this session (`supabase/migrations/20260717053750_profiles_update_with_check.sql`).
- Known operator-gated gaps already tracked in PLAN.md (do not re-report): missing Vercel env vars (Upstash, Calendly/Typeform signing secrets, Customer.io, GitHub token), GitHub secret-scanning/push-protection disabled, Twilio SMS MFA not started, `NEXT_PUBLIC_DATADOG_ENV` wrong value. These require dashboard/console access this session doesn't have — skip them.

What to actually check (broader than what's already tracked):
1. **RLS policy audit, every table**: read every file in `supabase/migrations/*.sql` and build the full current-state picture of policies on `profiles`, `projects`, `project_files`, `invoices`, `work_orders`, `work_order_attachments`, `leads`, `bookings`, `page_events`, plus `storage.objects` policies for both buckets. Flag: any UPDATE/DELETE policy with USING but no WITH CHECK, any policy that's overly broad, any table where RLS could theoretically be bypassed by a non-admin authenticated user.
2. **Webhook signature verification**: confirm `app/api/webhooks/calendly/route.ts` and `app/api/typeform/webhook/route.ts` actually reject unsigned/invalid-signature requests (not just log a warning), and that `app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts` does full signature verification before trusting payload data used for local status writes.
3. **Rate-limiting coverage**: which public-facing API routes have NO rate limiting at all (check every route under `app/api/*`)? `/api/lead` and `/api/github-repo` are known to have it — what about `/api/webhooks/*`, `/api/typeform/webhook`, `/api/intercom/jwt`, `/api/agent`?
4. **Secret handling**: grep for any hardcoded API keys, tokens, or credentials in source (not `.env*` files — actual `.ts`/`.tsx`/`.mjs` source). Check every `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` env var reference and confirm none of them are secrets that should be server-only.
5. **Admin gating consistency**: every `app/admin/*` page and `app/api/*` admin-only route — confirm `isAdminEmail()` or `requireAdmin()` is actually enforced, not just present in a sibling file.
6. **Input validation**: any POST/PUT/PATCH route handler or server action that accepts user input WITHOUT Zod (or equivalent) validation.
7. **Dependency CVEs**: run `pnpm audit` (Bash tool, from the repo root) and report any HIGH/CRITICAL findings.

Report back (final message, plain text): ranked findings with file:line, one-sentence vulnerability description, severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low), and one-sentence fix. Cap at ~20 most significant. Note explicitly if an area you checked is clean.

input.description: Cost optimization review
input.name: audit-cost
input.prompt: You are reviewing cost-optimization opportunities for `dobeu.net v3` at C:\Users\JeremyWilliams\repos\new-dobeu-net, on branch `feature/hardening-audit-and-landing-refresh`. This is a RESEARCH task — read and analyze only, do not write or edit any files. Read CLAUDE.md first for architecture/deployment context. Stack: Vercel (Fluid Compute / Active CPU pricing — charges for active CPU time + provisioned memory + invocations, not wall-clock GB-seconds), a second Vercel `oci` container service (`containers/function/`), Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage), Stripe, Resend, Upstash (rate limiting), Apollo, Customer.io, Composio + Anthropic (embedded agent), Datadog RUM. Check: 1. **Runtime choices per route**: grep every `export const runtime = ...` declaration under `app/api/*`. Nodejs runtime functions generally cost more / cold-start differently than edge under Vercel's model — flag any route using `nodejs` that doesn't strictly need it (per CLAUDE.md, Stripe webhook and OCI-adjacent routes need nodejs; others may not). 2. **The `oci` container service** (`containers/function/`) — a running container service has baseline cost even near-idle. Given CLAUDE.md describes it as "a scaffold/proof-of-concept... not yet a product surface" with a minimal `server.mjs` that just answers health checks, assess whether it's worth its ongoing infra cost today, or whether it should be paused/removed until there's an actual workload. 3. **Image handling**: check `next.config.ts` `images.formats`/`remotePatterns` and where `next/image` is used vs raw `` — unoptimized/uncached image transforms cost money per-transform on Vercel. 4. **Bundle size / `optimizePackageImports`**: is the `experimental.optimizePackageImports` list in `next.config.ts` covering all the heavy packages actually used (check `package.json` deps like `motion`, `lucide-react`, `@radix-ui/*`, `mixpanel-browser`, `posthog-js`)? Larger bundles cost more in egress and slow cold starts. 5. **Unbounded/loop-prone external API calls**: check `lib/agent/index.ts` and `scripts/agent.ts` for any risk of unbounded Claude/Composio API call loops (cost risk, not just correctness). Check `lib/apollo.ts`, `lib/customerio.ts` for retry logic that could cause request amplification. 6. **Supabase query efficiency**: check admin list-view queries (`app/admin/leads`, `app/admin/bookings`, `app/admin/users`, `app/admin/projects`) for N+1 patterns or missing `.limit()`/pagination — unbounded reads cost more and get slower as tables grow. Cross-reference against indexes defined in `supabase/migrations/*.sql`. 7. **Third-party script loading** (`app/layout.tsx`, `components/analytics-provider.tsx`) — redundant/overlapping analytics providers (PostHog + Mixpanel + GA4 + GTM + Datadog all firing) is both a perf and a cost-per-event consideration across 4-5 paid analytics platforms. Report back (final message, plain text): ranked findings, each with file:line where relevant, one-sentence description of the cost inefficiency, estimated impact (High/Medium/Low — qualitative, no need for dollar figures), and a one-sentence fix/recommendation. Cap at ~12 most significant.

input.prompt:
You are running a performance evaluation of `dobeu.net v3` at C:\Users\JeremyWilliams\repos\new-dobeu-net, on branch `feature/hardening-audit-and-landing-refresh`. This is a RESEARCH task — read and analyze only, do not write or edit any files. Read CLAUDE.md first for context.

Known baseline: mobile Lighthouse Performance is ~80 (target 90), tracked as a known deferred gap in PLAN.md — don't just re-state "mobile Lighthouse is low", actually find WHY and give specific fixes.

Check:
1. **Dynamic import coverage**: `app/page.tsx` already dynamic-imports `HowItWorks`, `Founder`, `FAQ`, `FinalCTA`, `StickyMobileCTA`. Check `components/landing/*` (Hero.tsx, Services.tsx, SubBrandsStrip.tsx, LeadForm.tsx, BookingTab.tsx, TypeformTab.tsx, LightboxProvider.tsx) — are the heavy embeds (Calendly `react-calendly`, Typeform `@typeform/embed-react`) truly lazy-loaded and not in the initial bundle? Check for any static imports of heavy third-party packages that should be `next/dynamic`.
2. **Image performance**: audit every `<Image>` usage across `components/landing/*` and `app/**` for correct `sizes` prop (mismatched sizes cause over-fetching), missing `priority` on above-fold images or incorrect `priority` on below-fold ones, and whether `Hero.tsx`'s avatar image (`FOUNDER.avatar`) is appropriately sized (this specific image is being removed in a later phase of this branch's work, so don't worry about optimizing it — just note if there's anything else).
3. **Font loading**: check `app/layout.tsx` for font loading strategy (next/font vs external `<link>`, `font-display` behavior).
4. **Third-party script load order**: `app/layout.tsx` script tags for GA4/GTM/Datadog — are they using `next/script` with appropriate `strategy` (`afterInteractive`/`lazyOnload`), or blocking-by-default?
5. **Client component boundary bloat**: any `"use client"` component that could be a Server Component instead (unnecessary client bundle weight) — spot-check `components/landing/*`.
6. **Animation cost**: `Hero.tsx`'s `ActivityTicker` and `WorkCards` both run `setInterval` polling — confirm they pause off-screen (already documented as fixed via `useInView`) and check for any OTHER interval/polling pattern in the landing components that doesn't pause off-screen or respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
7. **Database query patterns**: any admin list page doing sequential awaited queries that could be `Promise.all`'d, or fetching more columns/rows than the UI renders.

Report back (final message, plain text): ranked findings, each with file:line, one-sentence description, severity/impact (High/Medium/Low), and a one-sentence concrete fix. Cap at ~15 most significant, prioritized toward whatever most plausibly explains the mobile Lighthouse gap.
